item.title: Ghana’s Komba people receive complete Bible after 16 years of translation work
item.description: Ghana's Komba people received their complete Bible after 16 years of dedicated translation work.

item.title: 2 Timothy 3:16 is Logos' Bible verse of the year, Matthew was the most studied book
item.description: One of the most-studied Bible verses of the year is from 2 Timothy in the New Testament, according to an analysis of millions of Bible study sessions that tracked how believers worldwide are engaging with Scripture.

item.title: King Charles reflects on pilgrimage, reconciliation and hope in Christmas Day address
item.description: King Charles III used his Christmas Day speech to reflect on the significance of pilgrimage as he appealed to the nation "to cherish the values of compassion and reconciliation".

item.title: Who was St Stephen and why is he remembered on December 26?

item.title: Pope seeks prayers for peace in Christmas Day message
item.description: The Pope asked people to pray in particular for the "tormented people of Ukraine" in his Christmas Day 'Urbi et Orbi' message.

item.title: Gay Archbishop of Wales says some people have left Church over her appointment
item.description: The first openly gay Archbishop of Wales says her appointment has caused some people to leave the Church in Wales.

item.title: US carries out strikes on Islamic State in Nigeria over violence against Christians
item.description: The US military has conducted airstrikes against Islamic State (IS) militants in Nigeria over the violent "targeting" of Christians.

item.title: How to make the most of the quiet period between Christmas and New Year
item.description: Make the most of these last days of the year to slow down, reflect, and reconnect with God.

item.title: Over £900,000 awarded to help UK churches stay open amid growing funding pressures
item.description: Hundreds of churches across the UK are receiving vital financial support to remain open and safe, as rising repair costs and shrinking funding streams place historic buildings under increasing strain.

item.title: US criticises prosecution of pro-life campaigner over silent prayer near abortion clinic
item.description: The US State Department has said it is closely monitoring the prosecution of a Christian woman who prayed silently in an abortion clinic buffer zone.
